question: Pandit Kumar Gandharva received the _______ in 1977 for his contributions in the field of Hindustani Classical music.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Bhushan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Kumar Gandharva** was a renowned figure in the field of **Hindustani Classical music**.
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Bhushan** in **1977** for his significant contributions to Indian classical music.
 
• The **Padma Bhushan** is the third-highest civilian award in the Republic of India, instituted on **2 January 1954**.
 
• This award is conferred to recognize distinguished service of a high order to the nation, in any field.
 
• Pandit Kumar Gandharva's unique style and his contributions to the revival of classical music were instrumental in him being honored with this prestigious award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tansen Samman**__

 __
 
• The **Tansen Samman** is an award given by the **Government of Madhya Pradesh** to musicians who have made significant contributions to the field of Indian classical music.
 
• It is named after the legendary musician Tansen, one of the nine gems in the court of Mughal Emperor Akbar.
 
 
 
• **Padma Shri**__
 __
 
• The **Padma Shri** is the fourth-highest civilian award in the Republic of India, instituted on **2 January 1954**.
 
• This award is conferred to recognize distinguished contributions in various spheres of activity including the arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
 
 
• **Karnataka Ratna**__
 
 
• The **Karnataka Ratna** is the highest civilian honor of the state of Karnataka, India.
 
• It is awarded to individuals for their extraordinary contributions in any field.
 
• This award was first instituted in the year **1992**.
